description: Fix checkins.js 'Mã QR không hợp lệ' error. The quickCheckin() function generates a QR code on the fly but the backend may expect the member's actual QRCode from Members table (format M000001-M000020). Modify to fetch member profile (GET /api/Member/{memberId}) on page load, extract qrCode field, and use that value in POST /api/Checkin/qr body. Add duplicate check: if already checked in today (checkoutTime is null), show 'Đã check-in hôm nay' message instead of button.
steps: Read wwwroot/js/checkins.js quickCheckin() around line 88 - it generates qrCode as 'MEMBER_{memberId}_{timestamp}'
Read Controllers/CheckinController.cs POST /api/Checkin/qr - it expects { qrCode, memberId } but backend CheckinService likely validates QRCode against Members.QRCode field
Read Controllers/MemberController.cs GET /api/Member/{id} - returns member object with qrCode field (camelCase in response)
In renderMemberCheckins() (line 94), before rendering the Check In button, fetch member profile: const member = await apiFetch(`/api/Member/${memberId}`)
Extract member.qrCode (should be format M000001 etc per SQL seed data)
Store in a variable or pass to quickCheckin
Modify quickCheckin(memberId, qrCode) to accept qrCode parameter and use it directly in POST body (remove timestamp generation)
Add duplicate check: before showing Check In button, check if member has a checkin today with checkoutTime === null. If yes, show disabled button with text 'Đã check-in hôm nay'
Verify button click calls POST /api/Checkin/qr with { qrCode: member.qrCode, memberId }
acceptance_criteria: Member profile is fetched on check-in page load
QRCode from Members table is used (not generated timestamp)
Check-in succeeds without 'Mã QR không hợp lệ' error
If already checked in today (no checkout yet), button is disabled with 'Đã check-in hôm nay' text
After successful checkin, list refreshes to show new entry
verification: Login as member01/password (QRCode should be M000001)
Verify page loads and shows 'Check In' button
Click button - verify success toast '✅ Check-in thành công!'
Verify new checkin appears in table with current timestamp
Try clicking Check In again immediately - verify button disabled or shows 'Đã check-in hôm nay'
Check browser Network tab - verify POST body includes qrCode: 'M000001'
